scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names protocol,daemon,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --workspace @legible/protocol" "npm run dev --workspace @legible/daemon" "npm run dev --workspace @legible/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @legible/protocol && npm run build --workspace @legible/daemon && npm run build --workspace @legible/web && npm run stage:web --workspace @legible/daemon
scripts.pack:local: npm run build && node scripts/stage-package.mjs && npm pack ./dist/package --pack-destination ./dist
scripts.test:package: npm run build && node scripts/stage-package.mjs && LEGIBLE_PACKAGE_TEST=1 vitest run apps/daemon/src/cli/package.test.ts
scripts.check:npm: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:cli
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo check --workspace --locked && cargo test --workspace --locked && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.check: npm run check:npm && npm run check:rust
